candidateStatus: private structural probe source candidate; not built or run

source.sourcePackageMode: run the exact committed src/ofcli tree with python -m ofcli; no source patch or package resolver

runtime.requirementsExport: runtime-requirements.txt generated from every non-virtual lock package with all artifact SHA-256 values; pip installs only binary wheels and uses only https://pypi.org/simple
runtime.networkTls: aiohttp default verified TLS, supplied scoped test CA through SSL_CERT_FILE; never pass ofcli --insecure

ofcliUse.command: python -m ofcli trustchains ENTITY_ID --trust-anchor TRUST_ANCHOR --details --log-level WARNING
ofcliUse.output: parse issuers/sub identifiers in detailed chain JSON; never retain or display raw entity_statement JWTs
ofcliUse.negativeControl: optional unrelated anchor; require the pinned CLI no-trust-chain marker and zero emitted chains
ofcliUse.limits: one selected chain, 120-second command deadline, 4 MiB stdout cap, 64 KiB stderr cap

evidenceBoundary.reported: transport/TLS success, chain presence, exact structural iss/sub links, selected terminal anchor identifier, tool and source version
evidenceBoundary.notReportedAsVerified: entity-statement signatures, JOSE algorithms/kids, metadata-policy correctness, or Federation trustworthiness
evidenceBoundary.reason: pinned TrustTree.verify_signatures explicitly returns true with TODO verify signatures; chain traversal and policy output are not cryptographic acceptance
